description: Negative: daily vital reading with no timestamp in either accepted spelling
shaclConstraintViolated: health:DailyVitalReadingShape requires a timestamp through a node-level sh:or over cascade:date and health:date. This reading carries neither, so the sh:or is unsatisfied.
notes: The date is required through sh:or rather than sh:minCount because two live emitters spell it differently (health:date and cascade:date). Omitting both is the only way to violate it, and is exactly the failure that would drop a reading out of the time series it belongs to.
